notes: The caxa standalone binary is NOT byte-reproducible: caxa copies the app without preserveTimestamps and ignores SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH, so all ~31,800 tar-entry mtimes get the build wall-clock time; it also uses a random --identifier. The Go stub, gzip wrapper, and bundled node runtime are deterministic, so a ~2-line caxa change would fix it, but as shipped it cannot converge. Lodestar's trust model for the binary is attestation, not reproducibility: the npm package (@chainsafe/lodestar) and the Docker images carry SLSA provenance (verify with `npm audit signatures` / `gh attestation verify`). Build and report honestly; expect divergence.
